sourceContext: R16 schema-state reconciliation and V2/V3 corrective migration chain; supersedes terminal CP51-09 BLOCKED.
objective: Certify the exact minimal database delta for release 698c using schema-state reconciliation and the documented V2/V3 corrective migration chain.
why: R15 was blocked by treating an unavailable migration ledger as a schema blocker and by stopping at the documented V2 public_ref defect. R16 separates ledger evidence from schema state and applies only proven corrective effects in a local isolated target.
scope: Build target reference from canonical migration catalog
Compare baseline and target normalized schema state
Generate and apply only local executable reconciliation SQL
Run local contract checks and independent reviewers
acceptanceCriteria: All repository-permitted target artifacts are accounted for
forbiddenActions: change Production RLS, grants, RPCs or schema
verificationRequirements: Prove candidate convergence and rollback recreation
